# StarPower Collective

> StarPower Collective is an internet radio show from Harlem, New York, started in 2010. It interviews everyday people, and some well-known artists, about the music that shaped their lives. Tagline: "Every Life Has a Soundtrack." Motto: "Music is the shower of life!"

## Key facts
- Founded in 2010 in Harlem, New York, by the Founding Four: Derek B. (Power), Dano B. (SuperStar), Ron J. (Dast-One) and Sid W. (Da Creator).
- Streams on Nu Soul Hwy Radio. Listen live at https://starpowercollective.com (press Listen Live).
- Guests have included Kool Mo Dee, Inspectah Deck, Doctor Dré, Dennis Coffey, Don Blackman, Onaje Allan Gumbs, Josh Milan, Boyd Jarvis, LA Sunshine, Reggie Reg and many everyday community members.
- Creative family: Nu Soul Hwy Radio, Psyba Village, SPC Alumni Edition and Immoortal Souls (spelled with two o's), a family-legacy preservation service that grew out of the show.
- Anyone can apply to be a guest; no fame required.
- Contact: starpower.collective@gmail.com, (678) 466-0560.
- Site designed and powered by Moor Graphix (https://moorgraphix.com).

## Interview pages
- [Kool Mo Dee](https://starpowercollective.com/interviews/kool-mo-dee/): Hip-hop pioneer Kool Mo Dee on Michael Jackson, his mother's songs and why music is a language without words.
- [Inspectah Deck](https://starpowercollective.com/interviews/inspectah-deck/): Wu-Tang Clan's Inspectah Deck on his mother's 45s, Curtis Mayfield and using music as therapy.
- [Onaje Allan Gumbs](https://starpowercollective.com/interviews/onaje-allan-gumbs/): Pianist and arranger Onaje Allan Gumbs on music as healing, cooking up sound like a chef and his breakthrough with Norman Connors.
- [Don Blackman](https://starpowercollective.com/interviews/don-blackman/): Keyboardist Don Blackman on growing up in a house full of music, Funkadelic's "Knee Deep" and his first jazz concert.
- [Reggie Reg](https://starpowercollective.com/interviews/reggie-reg/): Reggie Reg of the Crash Crew on carrying DJ equipment down four flights, learning to cut and mix, and hip-hop's earliest days.
- [Dennis Coffey](https://starpowercollective.com/interviews/dennis-coffey/): Guitarist Dennis Coffey on his first session at 15, the wah-wah pedal at Motown and the slow-burn success of "Scorpio."
- [Josh Milan](https://starpowercollective.com/interviews/josh-milan/): Josh Milan on Fort Greene block parties, gospel at home and why he hears music as the voice of God.
- [Boyd Jarvis](https://starpowercollective.com/interviews/boyd-jarvis/): Producer Boyd Jarvis on Crown Heights Affair, a Boston community center that sparked his love of fusion jazz, and making "The Music Got Me."
